decisions.issues: Minor only. The boot shadows are cast straight onto the underside of the solid deck planks, which is physically loose but clearly reads as the scripted beat of running feet crossing overhead. The frame has no text, no noose (the ropes are coils and lashings), no open sky and no painted balloons. Grey-white light cuts through the seams and water drips down onto the beam. The low-detail dark planking along the top band (roughly y 0 to 0.2, left and right) takes both jagged balloons without covering the shadows. Tails go to the top edge because the sailors are off panel above.

Acceptable with minor deviations. The beat reads clearly. The guard is thrown backward off balance, both hands off the ladder. Nagoji drives his reversed musket butt two-handed into the guard's open wrist without being gripped. His wrist chain swings between the cuffs, the guard's musket spins away into the dark at right, lightning shows in the open hatch and no injury is shown. The setting matches 6.5, 7.3 and 7.4: a flat-tread companion ladder whose foot vanishes into black flood water with no dry planks, a lamp-lit timber hold and rain falling through the hatch. The guard has a morion, buff jerkin, cream shirt and cross-belt, with no cuirass and nothing red. Nagoji matches the sheet: thick curled moustache, clean chin, long curly hair, empty iron collar, torn ochre tunic, cream dhoti and bandaged manacled wrists. There is no text, blood or noose. Deviations: (1) This is a side-on medium-wide shot with full figures, not distant with small figures, though no injury is visible and at column width the figures print small. (2) Only his front foot is on a tread. The trailing foot is at the waterline, lifting out with a splash. (3) No hobble chain is drawn between the ankle cuffs, only short stubs. (4) The musket barrel is hidden behind his arm and torso, so only the stock shows. (5) The ear stud is tiny and reads dark rather than gold. (6) His far (left) forearm is bare between cuff and elbow, but no brand is drawn and the bandage and cuff cover the brand zone. Caption space: CAPTION 0 over the dark deck beams at top-left (x 0 to 0.35, y 0 to 0.28), clear of the lantern and figures. CAPTION 1 ('Bone cracked.') over the beams at top-right (x 0.78 to 1.0, y 0 to 0.14) or over the water at lower-right (x 0.7 to 1.0, y 0.88 to 1.0).

v05 gets Nagoji right: cheek pressed to the ladder, eyes squeezed shut, face turned from the fall, thick curled moustache, clean chin, clear gold ear stud, empty hinged collar with side ring, torn ochre tunic, cream dhoti, and a left forearm bandaged from wrist to mid-forearm with its inner side against the wood. The guard also works: seen from behind with his face hidden, morion, buff jerkin, cross-belt, cream sleeves, arms flung out, falling. Three problems rule it out. (1) Irons: an EMPTY iron cuff is clamped round the ladder's side rail. The wrist chain runs from his manacle down to it, and a second chain runs from it to his ankle cuff, so he reads as chained to the ladder, which breaks the escape logic and the bible rig. His second hand is not shown. (2) The ladder has round rungs, unlike the flat-tread companion ladder in 6.5, 7.1 (v12), 7.3 and 7.4. (3) The setting does not read as the ship's hold. It is a bare plank shaft open to the sky across its whole top, with no deck beams, lamps or cargo. At its foot is wave-tossed water fading to a horizon-like haze, so the guard seems to fall off the ship into the open sea. In 7.3 his body lies in the flooded hold. There is no text or gore.
decisions.correction: Keep v05's Nagoji exactly: pressed flat against the ladder with his cheek on the wood, eyes squeezed shut, face turned away from the fall, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, small gold ear stud, long curly hair, empty hinged iron collar with side ring, torn ochre sleeveless tunic, cream dhoti, and his left forearm bandaged from wrist to mid-forearm with its inner side against the wood. Also keep the guard seen from behind, face hidden, in morion, buff leather jerkin, cream shirt and cross-belt, arms flung out grasping at nothing, with cold lightning light from above. Fix three things. (1) IRONS: no cuff, shackle or chain touches the ladder. Show BOTH bandaged hands gripping the same flat tread, each in its own manacle, joined only to each other by one short slack chain about a forearm long. His two ankle cuffs are joined only to each other by their own short hobble chain. No chain runs between wrists and ankles, and there are no empty cuffs anywhere. (2) LADDER: make it the steep wooden companion ladder with flat treads and side rails from 6.5, 7.1, 7.3 and 7.4, not round rungs. (3) SETTING: this is INSIDE the ship's hold. Overhead is a closed timber deck with heavy beams, pierced by ONE rectangular hatch just above the ladder, where the lightning and rain show. Everything else around the shaft is the dark hold interior: beams, hull planking, lashed barrels and bales, and a warm hanging-lantern glow deep in the background. Far below, the guard drops toward black flood water covering the hold floor among the barrels at the ladder foot. No open sea, no waves, no horizon, and no sky beyond the one hatch. Silent panel: no text, no balloons, no caption boxes.
